activityDeck.baseText: Morning espresso at a neighbourhood bar

chaosVariants.low: Stand at the bar counter of a local café and drink your espresso the Roman way.
chaosVariants.medium: Order an espresso at four different bars within a 500m radius and compare them.
chaosVariants.high: Ask the barista to make you whatever they personally consider the perfect coffee. No arguments.

chaosVariants.low: Wander the cobblestone lanes of Trastevere before the tourists arrive.
chaosVariants.medium: Follow any cat you see for five minutes. See where Rome takes you.
chaosVariants.high: Knock on the first open courtyard gate you find and compliment whatever is inside.

chaosVariants.low: Order cacio e pepe at a trattoria away from the tourist centre.
chaosVariants.medium: Ask a local (not a waiter) where they actually eat cacio e pepe and go there.
chaosVariants.high: Eat cacio e pepe at a different restaurant for both lunch and dinner — and rank them publicly.

chaosVariants.low: Visit the Pantheon and spend 15 minutes doing nothing except looking up at the oculus.
chaosVariants.medium: Arrive just before a rain shower and experience the oculus in the rain.
chaosVariants.high: Time your visit for exactly noon and track the light beam from the oculus with your phone.

chaosVariants.low: Get two scoops of gelato and sit by the Campo de' Fiori fountain.
chaosVariants.medium: Ask the gelateria to build you a three-scoop combination that 'tells a story'.
chaosVariants.high: Get a scoop from every gelateria in the square. Rate them all on a spreadsheet.

chaosVariants.low: Book a slot at the Borghese Gallery and take your time with Bernini's sculptures.
chaosVariants.medium: Pick one sculpture and spend your entire visit drawing it, regardless of your skill level.
chaosVariants.high: Write a one-sentence dramatic backstory for every statue you see. Read it out loud, quietly.

chaosVariants.low: Find a wine bar in Pigneto and enjoy a Campari spritz with complimentary snacks.
chaosVariants.medium: Walk into any bar that looks lively and order whatever the person next to you is having.
chaosVariants.high: Challenge someone at the bar to a competitive olive count. Stakes: the next round.

chaosVariants.low: Walk up to the Gianicolo hill for the best panoramic view of Rome at sunset.
chaosVariants.medium: Bring a sketch pad (or just your phone) and draw the skyline silhouette as the sun drops.
chaosVariants.high: Strike up a conversation with a stranger at the viewpoint. Learn three things about their life.

chaosVariants.low: Find an old-school Roman osteria open late and order whatever offal dish is on the menu.
chaosVariants.medium: Ask the chef to feed you whatever they're most proud of tonight.
chaosVariants.high: Order the most unfamiliar thing on the menu and eat all of it. No googling allowed.

chaosVariants.low: Sit at a café on the edge of Piazza Navona and watch street artists work.
chaosVariants.medium: Commission a portrait from a street artist — any style they choose.
chaosVariants.high: Become a street performer yourself. Whatever your talent is, do it for 10 minutes.
